'''Belairah''' was once the [[Queen]] of [[Saldaea]].

== History ==
She was a great monarch, renowned for having married and put away her husband four times.{{ref/book|13|16}}

== Trivia ==
* Belairah is named for Judith Bélair-Kyle, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
